info.name: AWS Marketplace Discovery API
info.description:
# AWS Marketplace Discovery API

The AWS Marketplace Discovery API provides programmatic access to the AWS Marketplace catalog. Use these APIs to search and browse listings, retrieve product details and fulfillment options, and access public and private offer pricing and terms. All operations use POST with JSON request bodies and require AWS Signature Version 4 (SigV4) authentication.

This collection uses AWS Marketplace Discovery APIs, which require AWS Signature Version 4 (SigV4) authentication and are intended for server-to-server use. The Postman web (Cloud Agent) environment may not reliably support these requests due to agent connectivity, CORS, and signing constraints. **For best results, use the Postman Desktop App or Desktop Agent with properly configured AWS credentials. Do not expose AWS credentials in client-side or browser-based applications.**

For official documentation, refer to [Using the AWS Marketplace Discovery API](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/marketplace/latest/APIReference/discovery-apis.html).

item.name: All Actions

request.description:
# [GetListing](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/marketplace/latest/APIReference/API_marketplace-discovery_GetListing.html)

Retrieve full details for a listing, including descriptions, highlights, categories, badges, pricing models, pricing units, reviews, promotional media, seller engagements, and associated products and offers. Use the listingId from SearchListings results.

response.name: GetListing

request.description:
# [GetOffer](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/marketplace/latest/APIReference/API_marketplace-discovery_GetOffer.html)

Retrieve details for a specific offer, including the pricing model, seller of record, availability dates, badges (private pricing, future dated, replacement offer), and associated products and offer sets. Use the offerId from ListPurchaseOptions results.

response.name: GetOffer

request.description:
# [GetOfferSet](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/marketplace/latest/APIReference/API_marketplace-discovery_GetOfferSet.html)

Retrieve details for an offer set — a grouped collection of private offers for a multi-product solution. Returns the associated products and offers, seller of record, availability dates, and buyer notes. Use the offerSetId from ListPurchaseOptions results where purchaseOptionType is OFFERSET.

response.name: GetOfferSet

request.description:
# [GetOfferTerms](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/marketplace/latest/APIReference/API_marketplace-discovery_GetOfferTerms.html) 

Retrieve the commercial terms for an offer, including usage-based pricing, fixed upfront pricing, configurable upfront pricing, free trial periods, BYOL, legal documents, payment schedules, renewal terms, support terms, and validity terms. Each term includes rate cards, grants, or schedules as applicable. Use the offerId from GetOffer or ListPurchaseOptions.

response.name: GetOfferTerms

request.description:
# [GetProduct](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/marketplace/latest/APIReference/API_marketplace-discovery_GetProduct.html) 

Retrieve detailed product information including descriptions, highlights, categories, promotional media, seller engagements, manufacturer details, and fulfillment option summaries. Use the productId from GetListing's associatedEntities or SearchListings results.

response.name: GetProduct

request.description:
# [ListFulfillmentOptions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/marketplace/latest/APIReference/API_marketplace-discovery_ListFulfillmentOptions.html)

List the fulfillment options available for a product, including deployment details such as version information, operating systems, usage instructions, and release notes. Supports 12 fulfillment types: AMI, SaaS, Container, Helm, EKS Add-on, CloudFormation, API, EC2 Image Builder, Data Exchange, Professional Services, SageMaker Algorithm, and SageMaker Model. Requires a productId.

# [ListPurchaseOptions]([https://docs.aws.amazon.com/marketplace/latest/APIReference/API_marketplace-discovery_ListPurchaseOptions.html)

List the purchase options (offers and offer sets) available for a product. Filter by product ID, seller, purchase option type (OFFER or OFFERSET), visibility scope (PRIVATE), and availability status (AVAILABLE, EXPIRED). You must include at least a PRODUCT_ID or VISIBILITY_SCOPE filter. Returns offer summaries with seller, badges, availability dates, and associated entities.

response.name: ListPurchaseOptions

request.description:
# [SearchListings](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/marketplace/latest/APIReference/API_marketplace-discovery_SearchListings.html)

Search for listings by keyword, category, pricing model, fulfillment type, and other attributes. Returns listing summaries including name, description, publisher, badges, pricing models, and review ratings. Supports sorting by relevance or average customer rating. Use filters from SearchFacets to narrow results.

response.name: SearchListings

request.description:
# [SearchFacets](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/marketplace/latest/APIReference/API_marketplace-discovery_SearchFacets.html)

Retrieve available filter values and their counts for building browse and filter UIs. Returns facets for categories, pricing models, fulfillment option types, publishers, customer ratings, and more. Pass the same searchText and filters as SearchListings to get facet counts that reflect the current search context.
